fields.PRODUCT NAME: Blush Petal Hand block Cushion Cover
fields.DESCRIPTION: Add a soft and elegant charm to your space with our Blush Petal Hand block Cushion Cover. Featuring delicate pink floral motifs framed with a leafy green border, this 16x16 inch cover beautifully balances traditional design with contemporary aesthetics. Hand block printed on quality cotton, it’s perfect for brightening up sofas, armchairs, or bedroom décor.
